title: 第11章 二阶魔兽火焰巨蜥第12章 悲催的肥羊
lines: 在小刀的要求下，萧羽换了身黑色的劲装，并戴上了一个白色的骷髅面具！至于原因小刀的回答很简单：“杀人夺宝！”
对于小刀的说法，萧羽并不认同，萧羽不是嗜杀之人！
小刀对此嗤之以鼻，在落日山脉中有无数的灵药与机缘，甚至传说中，这里是上古时期的古战场，死去的大能不知有多少？
当然也会留下无尽的传说与机缘，而在这里也是犯罪的天堂，这里没有任何的顾忌与规矩！
就算你不抢别人，别人也会抢你！对此萧羽不置可否！
当然萧羽也问过小刀哪里来的这个面具，小刀只是告诉他，这个面具是它唯一保存下来的东西，其它的都随着身体的破碎而消失了！
这个面具没有别的能力，唯一的能力就是遮掩气息和魂力，而且遮掩的能力会随着使用者能力的提升而提升，用小刀说法就是天武境以下是不可能灵魂探查出萧羽的，也无法从气息中判断萧羽的身份！
萧羽心中也是惊骇，光是这样的一个能力就已经很逆天了。
萧羽一路行进，很快便进入了落日山脉，从起初还遇见不少来山脉的探险小队，到最后的孤身一人，毕竟这里实在是太大了！
萧羽小心翼翼的前进着，突然前方出现了一个长10米的大家伙，它并没有看到萧羽，只是懒洋洋的趴在草丛中，晒着太阳！嘴里好像还在咀嚼着什么。
走近了一看，露在外面竟是一个人腿！应该是哪个冒险者，在这里每时每刻都会上演死亡！可是第一次看到这样的场景还是让萧羽感到很不自然。
“人类把妖兽当作食物和资源，等级越高的妖兽，其血肉越是珍贵，而妖兽同样喜欢人类的血肉，因为同样对他们来说，越高的武者其血肉精华对妖兽的修行好处也会越大，这就是法则！所以没有什么好悲哀的！”
小刀悠悠的道：“这个大家伙的血可以用来磨练你的筋骨皮肤，还以用来刻画烈焰符，骨肉可以卖给酒楼作为食材，妖核可以卖给材料收购商！不用我说，你应该知道怎么做了吧？”
小刀的话音刚落，萧羽就一个闪身冲了出去，这时候，火焰巨蜥也发现了萧羽，一声嘶吼响起，这个大家伙看起来很笨拙，其实速度并慢！
一记摆尾狠狠向萧羽抽来，打了萧羽一个措手不及，萧羽只来得及把黑铁刀挡在身前便被抽飞了出去，直接撞倒了一棵大树，才停下来。
火焰巨蜥四蹄刨动，很快就冲到了萧羽近前，萧羽甚至看到了一丝戏谑的表情！因为萧羽身身上根本没有灵力的波动，所有它并没有感受到危险，在它看来萧羽就是自己跑出来给它加餐的！
嗯，一定如此！
萧羽翻身而起，强大的肉身并没有让他受到什么实质性的伤害！萧羽双腿叉开，右手握住刀把，将刀抗在肩膀上，同时左手向巨蜥勾了勾手指！
这是赤裸裸的挑衅！二阶妖兽的智慧已经不算低了，萧羽的举动无疑激怒了它！
“吼~”巨蜥再次冲来，张开巨口狠狠的向萧羽咬来，萧羽顺势一个侧翻，让了过去，同时围绕巨蜥不停的跑动，时不时在巨蜥的身上砍上几刀，巨蜥吃痛，更加愤怒了，这该死的小蚂蚁，实在是太讨厌了！
由于巨蜥体型巨大，而萧羽又一直紧贴着它奔跑，所以它很难对萧羽进行有效的攻击，终于被激怒的巨蜥张口喷出一道火焰，向萧羽射来！
萧羽一个跳跃企图躲避，可是火焰落地之后炸裂开来，萧羽的后背也是滋滋作响，一股烤焦的味道飘散开来。
萧羽强忍疼痛，落地后连着连着两个翻滚，左腿蹬地，借力再次腾空而起，将黑铁刀高高扬起，刀背紧贴后背，身体弯曲犹如拉满的弓，狠狠的向巨蜥的尾巴砍去。
“吼~”巨蜥痛苦的嘶吼，尾巴应声而断！鲜血喷洒！
巨蜥因为疼痛开始在地上翻滚，撞倒了周围的大树。
萧羽得手后，并没有停歇，身体倾斜，反向极速奔跑，长刀拖地，拉出深深一道土沟，趁着巨蜥翻滚刚刚起身的瞬间，来到巨蜥头颅的下方，长刀由下至上逆斩而上！一颗硕大的头颅掉落下来！
“这里的打斗一定会吸引其他的探险者，巨大的血腥味会引来其它的妖兽，把尸体收进储物袋，快撤！”小刀在萧羽的脑海催促道。
萧羽迅速的打扫了战场，然后迅速的消失在了丛林中。很快就有一队人出现在了这里，队伍大有5人，3男2女，都是劲装打扮，一看就是冒险小队！
一个男子仔细勘察了，现场。
“老大，看鞋印和血迹是一个人，斩杀了二级魔兽火焰蜥蜴，这个人的战力应该不错，至少在灵武境二重了！地上的血迹还有些温热，应该刚刚走，我们要不要追上去？”男子向领头人汇报道。
“这里是落日山脉，在落山日山脉里最可怕的事情不是遇到妖兽，而是受伤之后被人发现，仔细看战斗的痕迹，不是什么高手，因为灵武境巅峰或者地武境以上的高手，杀死二级妖兽最多不会超过三招，甚至会一击必杀！”
领头的男子阴狠的道：“所以，我断定他一定是个雏，而且还是个受伤的肥羊，走，追上去，他身上的一切都是我们的了！”

content_en:
At Xiaodao's request, Xiao Yu changed into a black outfit and put on a white skull mask! As for the reason, Xiaodao's answer is simple: "Kill people and seize treasures!"
Xiao Yu disagreed with Xiao Dao's statement. Xiao Yu was not a murderous person!
Xiaodao sneered at this. There are countless elixirs and opportunities in the Sunset Mountains. It is even said that this is an ancient battlefield in ancient times. How many powerful people have died?
Of course, endless legends and opportunities will be left behind, and this is also a paradise for crime. There are no scruples or rules here!
Even if you don't rob others, others will rob you! Xiao Yu was noncommittal about this!
Of course, Xiao Yu also asked Xiao Dao where he got this mask. Xiao Dao just told him that this mask was the only thing it preserved, and the rest disappeared as the body was broken!
This mask has no other abilities. The only ability is to cover the breath and soul power, and the covering ability will increase with the improvement of the user's ability. Using a knife to say it, it is impossible for people below the Tianwu realm to detect Xiao Yu's soul, and it is impossible to judge Xiao Yu's identity from the breath!
Xiao Yu was also horrified in his heart, just such an ability was already incredible.
Xiao Yu traveled all the way and soon entered the Sunset Mountains. From the beginning, he met many expedition teams who came to the mountains, to the end, he was alone. After all, this place is really too big!
Xiao Yu moved forward cautiously, and suddenly a 10-meter-long big guy appeared in front of him. It didn't see Xiao Yu, but lay lazily in the grass, basking in the sun! It seemed like he was still chewing something in his mouth.
When I got closer, I saw that it was a human leg exposed! Which adventurer should it be? Death will happen every moment here! But seeing such a scene for the first time still made Xiao Yu feel unnatural.
"Humans regard monsters as food and resources. The higher the level of monsters, the more precious their flesh and blood is. And monsters also like human flesh and blood, because for them, the higher the warrior, the greater the benefit of their flesh and blood essence to the monsters' cultivation. This is the law! So there is nothing to be sad about!"
Xiao Dao said leisurely: "The blood of this big guy can be used to sharpen your muscles, bones and skin, and can also be used to carve flame talismans. The bones and flesh can be sold to restaurants as ingredients, and the demon core can be sold to material buyers! Needless to say, you should know how to do it, right?"
As soon as Xiao Dao finished speaking, Xiao Yu dodged and rushed out. At this time, the flame giant lizard also discovered Xiao Yu, and roared. This big guy looked very clumsy, but in fact he was not very slow!
A swing of the tail hit Xiao Yu hard, catching Xiao Yu off guard. Xiao Yu only had time to block the black iron knife in front of him before he was whipped out and knocked down a big tree before he stopped.
The flame giant lizard moved its hooves and quickly rushed to Xiao Yu. Xiao Yu even saw a hint of joking expression! Because there was no fluctuation of spiritual power in Xiao Yu's body at all, it did not feel any danger. In its opinion, Xiao Yu just ran out to give it extra food!
Well, that must be the case!
Xiao Yu stood up, but his powerful body did not cause him any substantial damage! Xiao Yu spread his legs, held the handle of the knife with his right hand, put the knife on his shoulder, and at the same time hooked his fingers towards the giant lizard with his left hand!
This is a naked provocation! The intelligence of the second-level monster is not low, and Xiao Yu's actions undoubtedly angered it!
"Roar~" The giant lizard rushed over again, opened its huge mouth and bit Xiao Yu fiercely. Xiao Yu turned sideways and gave way. At the same time, he kept running around the giant lizard, slashing several times on the giant lizard's body from time to time. The giant lizard felt the pain and became even more angry. This damn little ant is really annoying!
Because the giant lizard was huge and Xiao Yu kept running close to it, it was difficult for it to attack Xiao Yu effectively. Finally, the enraged giant lizard opened its mouth and spit out a stream of flames, shooting at Xiao Yu!
Xiao Yu tried to escape by jumping, but the flames exploded after they hit the ground. Xiao Yu's back also sizzled, and a burning smell spread out.
Xiao Yu endured the pain and rolled twice in succession after landing. He kicked off the ground with his left leg and used the force to fly into the air again. He raised the black iron knife high, held the back of the knife close to his back, bent his body like a fully drawn bow, and slashed hard at the monitor lizard's tail.
"Roar~" The monitor lizard roared in pain, and its tail broke off at the sound! Blood sprays!
The monitor lizard began to roll on the ground due to pain, knocking down the surrounding trees.
After Xiao Yu succeeded, he did not stop. He tilted his body and ran in the opposite direction at high speed. His long knife dragged the ground and pulled out a deep ditch. Taking advantage of the moment when the giant lizard was rolling and getting up, he came to the bottom of the giant lizard's head and slashed backwards with the long knife from bottom to top! A huge head fell down!
"The fighting here will definitely attract other explorers, and the huge smell of blood will attract other monsters. Put the body in the storage bag and retreat quickly!" Xiao Dao urged in Xiao Yu's mind.
Xiao Yu quickly cleaned up the battlefield and then quickly disappeared into the jungle. Soon a team of people appeared here. There were 5 people in the team, 3 men and 2 women. They were all dressed up. At first glance, they were an adventure team!
A man carefully surveyed the scene.
"Boss, judging from the shoe prints and blood stains, it's a person who killed the second-level monster Flame Lizard. This person's combat power should be pretty good, at least at the second level of the Spiritual Martial Realm! The blood on the ground is still a little warm. He must have just left. Should we catch up?" the man reported to the leader.
"This is the Sunset Mountains. The most terrifying thing in the Sunset Mountains is not encountering monsters, but being discovered after being injured. Carefully look at the traces of the battle. It is not a master, because masters at the peak of the Spiritual Martial Realm or the Earth Martial Realm or above can kill the second-level monsters with no more than three moves at most, and may even kill them with one strike!"
The leading man said viciously
